ev.q: Moving air blurs the light of stars, which is why they appear to twinkle

1.why: A段。the reason why stars seem to flicker ↔ Moving air blurs the light of stars, which is why they appear to twinkle。C段也有“模糊”（blurred），但那是望远镜镜面的问题，不是星星闪烁的原因。

ev.q: the launch was delayed further after the Space Shuttle Challenger was destroyed in 1986

2.why: B段。an event that held up the launch ↔ the launch was delayed further after the Space Shuttle Challenger was destroyed in 1986。F段的航天飞机退役（2011）让望远镜无法维修，不是推迟发射。

ev.q: which worked rather like a pair of glasses

3.why: D段。a comparison between a repair and an everyday object ↔ a device containing small corrective mirrors, which worked rather like a pair of glasses。C段的“头发丝宽度”是用来比较误差大小，不是比较修复方法。

ev.q: The mistake was traced to a faulty testing instrument used during manufacture.

4.why: C段。how a manufacturing error came about ↔ The mistake was traced to a faulty testing instrument used during manufacture。

ev.q: can no longer be repaired, since the space shuttle was retired in 2011

5.why: F段。the reason why the telescope can no longer be serviced ↔ can no longer be repaired, since the space shuttle was retired in 2011。D段讲的是它当初为什么能被修好（designed to be visited and repaired），方向相反。

ev.q: arguing that a telescope placed in space, above the atmosphere, would produce far sharper images than any telescope on Earth

6.why: A段。argued that a telescope above the atmosphere would see more clearly ↔ arguing that a telescope placed in space, above the atmosphere, would produce far sharper images。

ev.q: the astronomer who had shown in the 1920s that the universe is expanding

7.why: B段。showed that the universe was growing larger ↔ had shown … that the universe is expanding。注意望远镜只是以他命名，B（由 Discovery 送入轨道）说的是望远镜，不是 Edwin Hubble 本人。

ev.q: installed a device containing small corrective mirrors

8.why: D段。fitted equipment that corrected the blurred images ↔ installed a device containing small corrective mirrors … as sharp as the original design had promised。G（称其为国家的耻辱）的主语是 Newspapers。

ev.q: The resulting image, known as the Hubble Deep Field, revealed around 3,000 galaxies

9.why: E段。showed thousands of galaxies ↔ revealed around 3,000 galaxies；a tiny area of sky ↔ a tiny, apparently empty patch of sky。E（主要观测红外线）说的是韦布望远镜。

ev.q: The mistake was traced to a faulty testing instrument used during manufacture.

10.why: C段。came from ↔ was traced to；defective ↔ faulty；when the mirror was being made ↔ during manufacture。不要填 main mirror：镜面是出错的东西，不是出错的原因。

11.why: D段。go outside the shuttle ↔ spacewalks；the 1993 mission ↔ The mission（In December 1993…）。Four further servicing missions 是之后的维修任务次数，不是太空行走次数。

ev.q: extending the telescope's working life far beyond the original plan of fifteen years

12.why: D段末句。When it was planned ↔ the original plan；expected to work for ↔ working life … of fifteen years。thirty years（F段）是它实际已工作的时间，不是原计划。

ev.q: it can see visible and ultraviolet light, which Webb cannot

13.why: F段。One advantage Hubble has over Webb ↔ which Webb cannot；detect ↔ see；as well as visible light ↔ visible and…。infrared 是韦布擅长的波段，正好相反。
